The '''Britteth''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] whose flesh was commonly eaten by [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. According to the Hutts, the taste of Britteth meat was improved if it was infused with the enzymes secreted by the creature when it died in pain.<ref name="Planet">''[[Planet of Twilight]]''</ref>
